law: A LANE THAT NEEDS ART FILES A REQUEST. IT DOES NOT COOK IT AND IT DOES NOT BLOCK.
how_it_works: ANY lane files a request here the moment it hits missing art. It keeps building around it.
The ART lane picks requests up, cooks candidates, and Paolo thumbs them.
A request is CLOSED only when the art is MEASURED in the surface he plays -- not when it is cooked, not when it is approved. gates/art_request_gate.js checks the marker.
That closes the loop that failed seven times in one month: approved art sitting in banks/ while the game drew something else.
